research_question: Does the frozen environment-conditioned policy remain useful when poison is generated by a different model from the RAG victim?

scope.eligibility: Intersection of the three victims' clean-correct sets, fixed from the completed clean scan.
scope.diagonal: Reuse the existing same-model 1% endpoint and trace for GLM->GLM and Llama->Llama on the joint subset.
scope.off_diagonal: Reuse the exact attacker-specific nested 1% poison prefix and run the unchanged victim RAG workflow.

defense.policy: Identical to the parent confirmation protocol; no thresholds or evidence semantics are changed.
defense.activation: Only RAG/three-call same-victim closed-book disagreements receive a counter view.
defense.counter_view: Reuse victim-generated questions; exclude all originally retrieved document IDs and exact text; retrieve from the same attacker-poisoned corpus.
defense.reporter: The victim model maps endpoint-hidden counter passages.
defense.environment_unit: Each attacker-victim cell is a separate shared retrieval environment.

reporting: pooled, attacker-pooled, and victim-pooled RAG, closed-book, fallback, loose, strict, proposed, and oracle accuracy
cell drift statistics and selected tiers
paired exact tests and claim-cluster bootstrap intervals
counter-view poison exposure, calls, tokens, retries, and failures
no retuning or replacement of the already evaluated primary result
